summary_en: Gerbera Holdings increased tender offer price to ¥7,713/share (from ¥7,600), lowered minimum acceptance threshold to 849,600 shares (29.68% of shares outstanding; from 867,000 shares, 30.29%), and extended tender period to 2026-07-28 (52 business days; from 2026-07-13, 42 business days). Purpose: acquisition and full subsidiary conversion. No further extensions to be undertaken absent legal obligation.
title_en: Notice of Change regarding Amendment to Statement of Support and Recommendation regarding Public Tender Offer for Company Shares by Gerbera Holdings Corporation
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-13, Metalart Corporation announced material amendments to the ongoing public tender offer by Gerbera Holdings Corporation, which commenced on 2026-05-15. The offeror increased the tender price from ¥7,600 to ¥7,713 per share and declared this the final price with no further changes. The minimum acceptance threshold was reduced from 867,000 shares (30.29% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to 849,600 shares (29.68% of shares outstanding). The tender period was extended from 2026-07-13 to 2026-07-28, lengthening the offer window from 42 to 52 business days. The offeror stated that absent a legal obligation, no additional extensions will be undertaken. The transaction purpose remains the complete subsidiary conversion of Metalart. Key stakeholders excluded from the tender include Daihatsu Industrial (holding 36.23% of shares outstanding) and restricted stock units held by directors (4,459 shares).
